name: WhoRiddle
tagline: Family riddle game with a new original “Who am I?” riddle every week
role: Mobile app, backend, CMS and website by the Softwhere team

scenes.title: A new original riddle every week
scenes.body: Each riddle has a deadline, limited attempts, points to earn and hints, all scheduled from a Strapi CMS.

scenes.title: Riddleverse: themed channels
scenes.body: Follow channels like Geography, Sports or Food, plus verified brand channels with their own challenges.

scenes.title: Points, ranks and invites
scenes.body: Solving riddles earns points; a scheduled Cloud Function re-ranks the leaderboard every five minutes.

scenes.title: Web riddles for restaurants
scenes.body: Guests solve a venue's riddle in the browser and show the screen to their server to claim a free treat.

scenes.title: One site for both stores
scenes.body: React site on AWS; Firebase Analytics logs store clicks and visits from referral links.
